field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Use unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF for current model tasks, [] for numeric/reducer work; also emit lowercase model_specs.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each check carries category, expected, observed, op, passed and principle; distinguish validity, support and benefit.
field_principles.attack_rows: Each deliberate corruption has a named check and observed rejection.
field_principles.audit_complete_score: Bare 0/1 measures complete independent accounting, not positive science.
field_principles.branch_dispositions: Valid nulls, invalid evidence and absent inputs have distinct outcomes.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure current work without padding; separate load, forward, generation, numeric work and validation.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host and record actual CPU/CUDA identities; historical board evidence is separate.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo why each field and gate exists so evidence is understandable independently.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Keep real reader flags; never clear a flag to open a gate.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names failed check, upstream, exact field/path, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ terminal findings, including complete_blocked_*; preserve a blocked_* conductor verdict if that is the actual source.
field_principles.independent_metric_rows: Per-group reconstruction makes headline disagreements inspectable.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Name actual native readout, bounded generation, numeric learning or artifact aggregation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_load_no_generation (2s), model_bounded_generation (10s), no_model_load or aggregation as declared; blocked_no_run only when nothing executed. Full generation (60s) is not used in this plan.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Balance attempted, complete, failed, cancelled and in-flight loads, forwards and generations.
field_principles.model_invoked: Any attempted current model call differs from archived or scripted events.
field_principles.phase_spans: Timestamped flushed progress and checkpoints expose long silent or unfinished operations.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name resources, exact paths, ownership and observed prerequisite values before dependent work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze ordering, fitting, audit and bootstrap seeds; deterministic reducers explain any null seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, protocol, data roles, model identity, raw shards and validation scope.
field_principles.rows: One row per independent group/game/seed/arm or event, including failures and censoring; large lists use hash-bound shards.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260921; retain measured UTC and monotonic times with clock/process identity.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Separate planned, attempted, complete, failed, censored, excluded and unstarted independent units.
field_principles.schema: Versioned schema with exact roadmap experiment_id, milestone and terminal status prevents silent reader drift.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact upstream bytes and their original flags/classes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Exact commands, exit codes, log hashes and required versus unrelated-baseline status establish validation scope.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. partial only for retryable own work, never unchanged external absence.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Declare whether the acceptance verifier is the evaluation oracle; if true, positive is forbidden and fixture positives are circular_positive.
